fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto a target and land among its company, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bite and Bound
fusions.desc: A nip that deals 7 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and makes you move 20% faster for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spring Again
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and hops you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Itch to Jump
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
